designs.title: How to Go to Bed
designs.why: The joke lands at a glance: four 'Turn around.' steps in a row is the whole gag, and the brush line has real life and weight variation and reads clean in one ink on both tees. The grid is calm and the italic captions sit well. What holds it back: the payoff is weak because step 7 'Sigh.' is basically step 6 redrawn with a small tick mark, so the punchline frame looks like a repeat. Some poses also get muddled (the back legs in step 2, the knot of lines in step 4), and the stiff all-caps serif title feels more like a gift shop than an artist's hand next to the loose brushwork.
designs.fix: Redraw step 7 as its own payoff, a dog melted flat or sunk deep with a big brushed exhale and slack ears, so it clearly reads as a different, final moment and not a copy of 6. Then hand-letter the title in the same brush so the type and drawings feel like one hand.
